notes: Astrophysical ALP-photon constraint from Chandra HETG/LETG spectroscopy of quasar H1821+643 in cool-core cluster CL1821+643. Main result: g_agamma > 6.3e-13 GeV^-1 excluded for m_a < 1e-12 eV at 99.7% (3sigma) credibility (assuming beta=100). A tighter 95.5% CL bound of 5.0e-13 GeV^-1 also quoted. Bound is essentially mass-independent (flat) for m_a < 1e-12 eV; encoded as horizontal line spanning the plotted mass range (~1e-19 to 1e-12 eV). Not a DM haloscope, so no local density assumption. confidence_level set to 0.95 as nearest allowed value to the paper's quoted 99.7% credibility.
